body.name: \(\mathscr F_n\) and \(\mathscr Q_n(f)\)
body.construction: Let \(\mathsf B_{k,K_n}\), \(1\le k\le K_n+d\), be the normalized order-\(d\) B-splines on \(\mathcal A\). The density sieve is \(\mathscr F_n=\{f=\sum_{k=1}^{K_n+d}c_k\mathsf B_{k,K_n}:c_k\in\mathbb R,\ |c_k|\le(R_f+1)K_n^{1/2},\ f\ge0,\int_{\mathcal A}f=1,\ f|_I\ge\kappa/2,\ \|f\|_{H^{\beta}(\mathbb R)}\le R_f+a_{f,n}\}\). For \(f\in\mathscr F_n\), the marked sieve is \(\mathscr Q_n(f)=\{q=\sum_{k=1}^{K_n+d}d_k\mathsf B_{k,K_n}:d_k\in\mathbb R,\ |d_k|\le(R_q+B_Y+1)K_n^{1/2},\ \|q\|_{H^{\beta}(\mathbb R)}\le R_q+a_{q,n},\ |q(a)|\le B_Yf(a)\text{ for every }a\in\mathcal A\}\).
